name: Zona Bezmolviya
source:
"I had a dream. Not just a random nighttime image, but a vivid, piercing vision.

Before me was a camp: tall trees, trees reaching up to the sky, and golden light breaking through their canopy.
However, the serenity of this place was mixed with something alien. The air trembled with a silent anxiety, the kind you feel even without knowing its source.

But what does this dream even mean if the place I saw so clearly is nothing more than an internet horror story, just another creepypasta whose events are not backed up by any official sources? The dream about the camp faded from memory, as all dreams do, giving way to reality. But everything changed when I stumbled upon a certain post...

My name is Vladislav Vedaev. I am setting off in search of the abandoned Sovyonok pioneer camp. Over and out."

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3592577431]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“我做了一个梦。不仅仅是一个随机的夜间图像，而是一个生动、敏锐的景象。

我面前是一座营地：高大的树木，高耸入云的树木，金色的光芒透过树冠。
然而，这个地方的宁静却夹杂着一些陌生的东西。空气因无声的焦虑而颤抖，即使你不知道其来源，你也会感受到这种焦虑。

但如果我如此清晰地看到的地方只不过是一个网络恐怖故事，只是另一个令人毛骨悚然的意大利面，其事件没有任何官方消息来源支持，那么这个梦到底意味着什么呢？就像所有的梦想一样，关于集中营的梦想从记忆中消失，让位于现实。但当我偶然发现某个帖子时，一切都改变了……

我的名字是弗拉迪斯拉夫·维达耶夫。我正出发去寻找废弃的苏维约诺克拓荒者营地。一遍又一遍。”

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3592577431]Steam[/url]]
